style: Stylized heroic fantasy painting in the look of a hand-painted 2D animated fantasy cinematic short: bold simplified shapes, slightly heroic sturdy proportions (broad shoulders, solid armour and props), heavy confident painterly brush strokes, hand-painted textures, rich saturated colour with a limited palette per scene, strong warm rim light against deep cool shadows, big areas of calm empty darkness, atmospheric haze between clear foreground, middle ground and background layers, cinematic widescreen composition. No ink outlines and no comic line art: edges are defined only by paint and light. Grounded anatomy and believable faces with real weight and emotion, semi-realistic like a painted cinematic short, not a cartoon, not a comic, not photorealistic, not a book illustration. Full-bleed image edge to edge: no black bars, no letterbox, no text, no letters, no logos, no borders, no frame, no watermark.

cast.lucien: Lucien Vale, a young half-elf wild magic sorcerer who loves to sing and play music, a good-hearted man who was betrayed: long straight blond hair, pointed elf ears, clean-shaven open friendly face, warm kind eyes carrying quiet sorrow, weary from betrayal, a faint gentle smile that does not hide his sadness, burgundy velvet long coat with brass buttons over a dark shirt, leather belt with a dagger whose blade glows faintly blue, faint purple arcane sparks flickering at his fingertips, a lute on his back, slim build. Sympathetic hero, never sinister or villainous
cast.arthas: Arthas, a tall devout human paladin: full dark steel plate armour, a dark cloth hood always worn up over a closed steel helm (hood visible in every view), two burning orange eye slits, broad shoulders, heavy bronze-hilted longsword, a faded holy sun emblem on his chest
cast.cedric: Cedric 'Cold-Eye', a human monk: shaved head, short dark beard, hard pale grey eyes, red and brown leather monk wraps over a green tunic, one bronze dragon-shaped shoulder pauldron, prayer beads, a long wooden staff, wiry strong build
cast.severin: Severin, a tall pale woman of the forest: very long straight silver-white hair, dark moss-green hooded ranger cloak, faint mint-green glowing eyes, calm unreadable face, a soft green light around her
cast.baphomet: Baphomet, a goat-headed demon imprisoned deep beneath a moonlit lake, only ever seen as an enormous face beneath its black water, never rising out of it: long curved black horns, matted dark fur, cracked skin glowing like embers, burning yellow eyes
cast.pig: the Pig, a hulking humanoid butcher about three metres tall with the head of a pig: heavy jowls, short tusks, small cruel eyes, reddish-pink skin, a leather butcher's apron soaked in blood, thick arms, a huge broadaxe
cast.valerys: High Inquisitor Valerys, the stern father of Arthas and Cedric: a tall man in his sixties, close-cropped grey hair and a short grey beard, hard pale grey eyes, white and crimson inquisitor robes with a gold sun emblem on the chest, a heavy gold chain of office, a calm unreadable face
cast.prisoner: the last prisoner, a gaunt townsman of Stagford in his thirties: torn grey rags, dark stubble, hollow cheeks, shackled wrists, dirty and exhausted

shots.scene: Establishing shot of the Pig's slaughterhouse deep inside a mountain: vast cut-stone halls, meat hooks and chains, braziers, a massive pool of blood glowing dark red in the middle of the great hall, smoke hanging in the air
The Pig at the edge of the blood pool: a hulking humanoid butcher with a pig's head, a blood-soaked leather apron, raising a huge broadaxe, braziers behind him
The three brothers driving the Pig back around the great pool of blood: Arthas's sword, Cedric's staff, Lucien throwing fire, the butcher stumbling
High in the great hall's wall, a barred window of a room already ablaze, thick black smoke pouring out over the hall
Lucien Vale lowering his burning hand, the fire in his palm dying, his face lit from below as he realises what the burning room holds
Silhouettes of prisoners behind the flames of the burning window, only shapes in the fire and smoke, leave the rest to imagination
Close-up of Lucien Vale in anguish, tears cutting through soot on his face, eyes up toward the burning room, God forgive me
The great hall filling with black smoke, the three brothers small figures by the blood pool, Lucien sinking to his knees
The Pig dragging Arthas the paladin down under the surface of the blood pool, the dark plate armour sinking, a great splash of dark red
The Pig falling dead backwards into his own pool of blood, the broadaxe slipping from his hand, a wave of dark red
Lucien and Cedric hauling Arthas out of the blood pool onto the stone edge, all three broken, torn and gasping
The room next door: everything grey with ash and cinders, two still shapes under the ash on the floor, thin smoke, no detail
Black water seeping out of cracks in the raw rock wall deep in the mountain, running down like veins
A stone basin where the black water gathers and mixes with blood, oily and dark, a faint sickly shine
A painted map-like vista of the island of Alaron at night seen from the mountain, rivers and streams turning black as ink, spreading across the land like veins
The draining hall: rows of stone slabs with empty iron shackles, channels in the floor dark with old blood, cages hanging from the ceiling, empty
Arthas and Cedric standing grim among the stone slabs of the draining hall, torchlight on their faces
Lucien Vale alone in cold light at the end of the draining hall, staring at the empty shackles, every truth cutting deeper
Wide shot: the three brothers standing on a ledge looking out over the vast underground slaughterhouse, red light from the blood pool far below
Looking down from high above into the endless halls under the mountain, tiny torches, hooks and chains, the red glow of the pool
Far away across the land, the walled city of Stagford on a plain, gates broken open, thin smoke rising, not a soul in sight
An empty street in sacked Stagford, doors hanging open, abandoned carts, a child's toy on the cobbles, grey light
Lucien Vale walking with a small flame burning in his open hand, his face half in shadow, carrying the fire and the blame
Pale ghostly faces of the people of Stagford in the smoke around Lucien Vale, whispering, his eyes closed
The last prisoner, a gaunt man chained in a cage in the draining hall, head down, torchlight through the bars
The prisoner lifting his head, his eyes now glowing a cold mint green, another will speaking through him
A faint translucent ghost of Severin, silver hair and green hood, appearing over the chained prisoner as she speaks through his mouth
A vision: the black lake at night, Baphomet's enormous goat face beneath the black water, chains straining around it
The prisoner's thin hand holding out through the bars a small glass vial of glowing green elixir
A vision: the chains around the black lake bursting in fire, Baphomet's burning eyes rising toward the surface, flames on the water
Lucien Vale telling his brothers what he heard, the three of them by torchlight in the draining hall
Arthas shaking his hooded head in doubt, arms crossed, not believing that Severin was forced into any of this
Close-up of Cedric Cold-Eye's sharp, still, pale grey eyes, watching, saying nothing
Close-up: Lucien's hand pouring the glowing green elixir out onto the stone floor, it hisses and smokes away
Lucien Vale walking alone down a dark tunnel toward faint light, his brothers far behind him
The nave of a grand stone church, a great window over the altar, rows of pews and candles, a channel of black water running down the side of the nave
High Inquisitor Valerys at the altar listening, his sons Arthas and Cedric before him, Lucien a step behind
Close-up of High Inquisitor Valerys, his face calm and unreadable, he does not flinch
An iron grate set in the church floor, darkness beneath it, two red eyes glinting far below
Lucien Vale in the church glancing from the grate in the floor to the Inquisitor, narrow suspicious eyes
High Inquisitor Valerys's eyes in shadow beneath the great window, a silence hiding behind his gaze
Lucien Vale alone outside the church at night, looking back at its lit windows, uncertain
